Quick triage update — infra observations:
- Root signal is KV-cache thrashing on RB-QB-17 when sequence reuse hits a rare codepath; sustained tail amplification is increasing queue depth.
- A subset of requests are landing on a hot worker with degraded kernel performance (suspected CUDA driver GC event at ~06:35).

Immediate remediations (in-progress):
1) Traffic steering: routing rule deployed to send checkout endpoints to Horizon-lite. Should reduce p99 by ~40% within 60s.
2) Hot-worker isolation: draining the affected worker and redistributing slots. ETA 10–15m.
3) Burst authorization request: need ops/leadership sign-off to grant +15% GPU burst on RB-QB-17 for 2 hours to shorten backlog.

I'll attach a short CSV with pod-level metrics for the last 90m (pool-metrics-07nov.csv). Vanessa — for the burst, if leadership approves I can enact immediately and follow with a post-mortem and kernel rollback if necessary.
